name: dsh-credential-vault
description: Credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: store server passwords, GitHub tokens, API keys and database secrets AES-256-GCM encrypted under $DSH_HOME, exposed through one `credential` tool. The default path (`action:"use"`) returns only a DSH_CRED_* variable name whose value dsh-shell-env injects into each shell call, so the secret never enters the conversation; `action:"reveal"` is the audited escape hatch that does return plaintext. A system-prompt section lists what is stored on every assembly so the model checks the vault before asking the user. HTTP API responses never carry secret material.
